expression_fold_result_protocol.meaning: expression_result_protocol_equivalence admits a contents-only (literal) replacement when the original result recipe is PooledValue (constant operator tree, already a pooled literal in C >= 8.5) or a NumericOperation whose normal result type is Int. This applies inside the shared check, so both the optimiser fold entry (optimiser/mod.rs eval_expression_at) and SCCP stored/returned constants (sccp/original_value_facts.rs) are admitted. The accepted difference is object identity/representation and literal sharing only, observable solely via tcl::unsupported::representation.
